business_summary: Peiport Holdings Ltd., an investment holding company, provides thermal and self-stabilized imaging, and general aviation products and services in the Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, and internationally. It operates in three segments: Thermal Imaging Products and Services; Self-Stabilized Imaging Products and Services; and General Aviation Products and Services. It offers gimbal systems; rotax engines; thermal integration systems, such as unmanned aerial thermographic inspection systems and infrared body temperature screening systems; infrared and ultraviolet cameras; and optoelectronics consisting partial discharge monitoring systems, nano positioning systems, electrical ultrasonic and x-ray inspection systems, fully automatic timing for sports, videoscopes and borespores, ground penetration radars, concrete imaging systems, motion analyzing systems, high speed imaging systems, ultra-portable explosives trace detectors, acoustic imaging camera, thermal imagers test systems, motor, and identiFINDER R400. It also provides thermal imaging products under the PTi and other brand names primarily for general consumption, commercial, and industrial fields. In addition, it offers self-stabilized imaging products and services mounted on aircraft, helicopters, vessels, and ships under the SkyEye, SeaVision, and PGs brand names, as well as rents self-stabilized imaging products for aircrafts and provide training and technical assistance services. Further, the company distributes general aviation products and services, including light and ultra-light aircraft engines and related components; and offers maintenance training courses, as well as maintenance and support services to light and ultra-light aircraft manufacturers, flight schools, flying entertainment clubs, light aircraft research institutions, and private flight owners. Peiport Holdings Ltd. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Causeway Bay, Hong Kong. Peiport Holdings Ltd. is a subsidiary of Peiport Alpha Ltd.
